title: Brownsville Ship Channel seawater desalination concept (25 MGD initial)
source: Dannenbaum Engineering and URS, Lower Rio Grande Valley Brownsville Seawater Desalination Demonstration Project Feasibility Study, November 2004, for the Brownsville Public Utilities Board and the Texas Water Development Board

documents.title: Brownsville seawater desalination feasibility study, November 2004

question: Can this 25 MGD concept hold about 60 percent overall recovery and the finished-water duty on the cold, salty corner of the ship-channel record (about 60 F and 49,000 mg/L TDS) with one seawater train out of service? What limits it first, and what is the cheapest way to stay at 25 MGD?
data_note: Design numbers are the 2004 Brownsville feasibility study only. The drawing is drawn by PlantAgent on that flowsheet. No operating historian is attached. A later pilot report is not a project document and is not loaded with this case.
